title: Avatar Bending game but Competitive
author: Quadrelia
selftext:
*This is an older trailer – the game looks way better now!* ✌🏼

Hey everyone!  
I know AI in game dev can be a controversial topic, and ideally, everything would be coded and designed from scratch.

However, I truly believe that a **competitive game centered around element bending** has massive potential. To bring this vision to life, I’ve been using AI tools to get things off the ground.

That said, AI can’t replace real expertise and hands-on experience – which is why I’m looking for help! If you love the concept and want to bring your game dev skills to the project, you’re more than welcome to join.

**What I bring to the table:**  
Solid marketing and community building. Thanks to years of experience (mainly on Instagram), I can make sure the game gets the traction and visibility it deserves.

If you have experience in game development and want to collaborate, feel free to reach out!  
💬 **Discord:** ⁠Domi5k⁠ *(Feel free to send a message or jump on a quick call!)*
